purpose: Supplementary southern boundary visual QA against the final r04_c05 candidate. Earlier historical reports are preserved.
method: Four 1024x320 strips made by exact native-pixel crop/paste: upper 160 rows from r03_c05 bottom edge, lower 160 from final r04_c05 top edge. All four actually viewed using original-detail image viewer as one unscaled labelled batch. No resize, interpolation, image generation or source image edits.

items.finding: 北侧木门板及竖框接到南侧金色边框、红墙和红柱，实体类型及竖框位置冲突。新材质窄带没有修复结构不连续。
北侧木门板与柱条直接切接南侧大红灯笼，灯笼弧面与轮廓在边界处无北向延续。
北侧整片木门板接到南侧灯笼右缘、墙面、竖柱和格栅窗，材质与框线结构均未衔接。
北侧木门板和红色竖柱接到南侧浅色窗格；窗框位置、面材及主体对象均有整段硬切。

conclusion: Latest true candidate comparison still fails all four southern segments. This supplement supersedes the old southern candidate comparison for the stated final hashes; it does not revise the historical QA or claim that a southern repair was attempted.
